movie.title: Voidance
movie.overview: To join the elite ATIC Guard, Alana Toro must pass one final test: enter a simulation, prevent a terrorist attack, and prove her loyalty. Every mistake resets the clock. Every death disappears - except in her memory, where the weight keeps building. The more Alana learns, the more she begins to question the organisation she fought so hard to join.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: To join the elite ATIC Guard, Alana Toro must survive a brutal, repeating simulation where every failed attempt to stop a terrorist attack chips away at her sanity and loyalty.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Aspiring ATIC Guard recruit Alana Toro faces a grueling final evaluation: a high-stakes simulation tasked with preventing a deadly terrorist attack. However, the simulation resets with every failure or death, leaving Alana as the only one who remembers the psychological trauma of each cycle. As the physical and mental toll mounts, she uncovers unsettling truths about the trial and begins to question whether the organization she is dying for is worth her allegiance.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Alana Toro has spent her entire life training to earn a spot in the prestigious ATIC Guard, a high-ranking defensive organization. Standing between her and her dream is one final test—a state-of-the-art simulation designed to test strategic efficiency, mental fortitude, and absolute loyalty under pressure. Her objective is simple yet grueling: infiltrate a simulated environment and successfully thwart a devastating terrorist attack. However, the trial operates under strict rules where any misstep or fatality immediately resets the clock back to the beginning. While the simulated world resets cleanly, Alana retains full memory of her violent deaths and tactical errors, causing an overwhelming weight of psychological trauma to accumulate with every loop. As she endlessly refines her tactics to survive, Alana begins discovering hidden anomalies and veiled data within the program's code. These revelations reveal disturbing motives behind the ATIC Guard's operations that extend far beyond a simple loyalty test. Caught between her lifelong ambition and her breaking conscience, Alana must navigate the deadly loop one last time to decide if she will obey orders or shatter the system from within.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Voidance is a high-concept sci-fi thriller following Alana Toro, an ambitious recruit determined to earn her place in the elite ATIC Guard. Her final hurdle is a brutal evaluation inside a hyper-realistic simulation where she must neutralize a terrorist threat. The catch: every mistake resets time, and every death leaves a permanent scar on her memory. As the boundary between the test and reality blurs, Alana uncovers dangerous secrets hidden within the simulation, forcing her to confront a terrifying choice between obedience and truth.

story_structure.climax: Alana faces a critical breaking point where she must decide whether to complete the simulation according to ATIC's commands or act on the disturbing reality she has uncovered.
story_structure.conflict: The simulation resets upon every failure or death, leaving Alana as the only one who retains memories of each failed attempt as the psychological toll begins to mount.
story_structure.resolution: Alana accepts the consequences of her choice, permanently altering her relationship with the ATIC Guard and setting a new trajectory for her future.
story_structure.introduction: Alana Toro stands on the brink of joining the elite ATIC Guard, facing one final test: a high-stakes simulation where she must prevent a devastating terrorist attack to prove her loyalty.
story_structure.risingAction: As cycle after cycle passes and Alana unravels hidden truths within the simulation, her growing awareness leads her to question the true motives and morality of the ATIC Guard.
